invariants.why: the core design decision: InstancedMesh per block type, not global and not per cell
setMatrixAt without needsUpdate is silent no-op; this must survive any edit
hidden-cell culling is a pre-pass; running it after creating instances wastes the work
the slot reuse mechanism; describing allocation without it would miss the performance story

invariants.must_contain: shadow quad per cube is NOT instanced
invariants.why: each quad needs its own world position for the shadow map; grouping them under InstancedMesh would break shadows between stacked cubes
